findings.title: Token `access_token` has static secret-like literal evidence
findings.description: Source evidence contains a static token/API-key style literal. The value is redacted in reports, but the code path should not carry runtime secrets in source.
findings.suggested_fix: Move runtime token values to approved secret storage and keep source/config references value-free.
findings.reviewer_question: Is this placeholder-only fixture code, or can production source contain a token value here?

findings.title: Cookie `legacy_session` sets SameSite=None without Secure evidence
findings.description: SameSite=None was detected, but Secure attribute evidence was not detected for this cookie-setting call.
findings.suggested_fix: Set Secure whenever SameSite=None is used.
findings.reviewer_question: Is this cookie intentionally available in cross-site requests?

findings.title: Cookie `legacy_session` does not set Secure
findings.description: No Secure attribute evidence was detected for this cookie-setting call.
findings.suggested_fix: Set Secure for cookies that should only be sent over HTTPS.
findings.reviewer_question: Is this cookie ever used in an externally reachable production environment?

findings.title: Session-like cookie `legacy_session` does not set HttpOnly
findings.description: No HttpOnly attribute evidence was detected for this cookie-setting call.
findings.suggested_fix: Set HttpOnly on session cookies so client-side scripts cannot read them.
findings.reviewer_question: Is this cookie intended to be inaccessible to browser JavaScript?

findings.title: Refresh token `refresh_token` has logout evidence without family revocation
findings.description: Logout and refresh-token lifecycle evidence were detected in linked source context, but no source-bound user-scoped or refresh-family revocation evidence was linked for the logout flow.
findings.suggested_fix: Revoke the user's refresh-token family, delete user-scoped refresh-token records, or remove the refresh-family cache key during logout.
findings.reviewer_question: Where does logout revoke every refresh token in the `refresh_token` family or for the current user?

findings.title: Session regeneration evidence was not found near login
findings.description: An authentication transition was detected, but nearby static evidence did not show an explicit session regeneration, cookie reissue, or recognized framework-default rotation point.
findings.suggested_fix: Regenerate the server-side session with [REDACTED](...) after authentication and privilege changes before storing the authenticated user state.
findings.reviewer_question: Where is the session identifier rotated after this authentication transition?

findings.title: Cookie `legacy_session` has no explicit expiry evidence
findings.description: No Max-Age or Expires evidence was detected for this cookie-setting call.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit Max-Age or Expires value when the cookie should have a bounded lifetime.
findings.reviewer_question: Should this cookie be session-scoped, or should it have an explicit lifetime?

findings.title: Cookie `session` has dynamic expiry evidence
findings.description: Cookie lifetime appears to depend on dynamic Max-Age or Expires evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the effective cookie lifetime and document the production value.
